verdict.rationale: The evidence documents built-in deployers only for Vercel, Netlify and Cloudflare, plus deployment to Mastra Cloud. These are managed or serverless platforms, not self-host targets. Nothing in the pack shows a maintained guide for Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS or a Raspberry Pi. Shipping apps as standalone endpoints is at most an adjacent building block, not an official deployment path for those targets.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide
